snippet.title: FAYE FALLING - Indie RPG - OUT NOW !
snippet.description:
OUT NOW on Steam ! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1865750/Faye_Falling/
Also available on PlayStation and Switch!

In Faye Falling you play as a recently passed soul, unable to recall who they are, or how they died. After a chance encounter with a powerful entity, you begin an epic journey to defeat a growing darkness, while recovering your memories along the way...

COMBAT
* Engage in fun, fast-paced turn-based battles against a large variety of enemies.
* Evade damage by dodging enemy attacks in quick, snappy minigames.
* Cast powerful spells to fight your opponents and protect yourself.

EXPLORATION
* Explore a diverse, ethereal world, filled with minigames, puzzles and secrets.
* Complete optional side quests to receive rare items and gear.

STORY
* Lead a path of darkness, where you'll steal, kill and grow horns, or a path of light, where you'll spread hope and sprout a glowing halo.
* Meet several strange characters along your journey; from an anxious skull, to a trio of divine angels.
* Make significant narrative choices that'll lead you toward multiple endings. (Including a hidden true ending.)
* Unlock a New Game+ mode with increased difficulty, and additional lore.

Faye Falling is an emotional gameplay experience that explores death, suffering and meaning. It was made entirely by one person; me!
